Every kind of job the panel runs, 40 types in all, grouped as the filters on **Automations → All jobs** group them. The id under each name is what the API and the job log use.

## How lanes work

A lane decides what a job waits for. Jobs in one lane run one at a time, and jobs in different lanes run side by side.

| Lane | What waits for what |
| --- | --- |
| Server | One job at a time per server: the site's server, or the server the job works on. |
| Both servers | A move holds the lanes of both servers it works on. |
| Shared queue | Jobs that belong to no server run one at a time among themselves. |
| A named lane | Jobs in a named lane run one at a time within it, beside the server lanes. A lane marked one per server has a lane for each server. |

The lanes and starters below are read from the places in the code that queue each job. Every job a person starts in the panel goes through the same API.

## Sites

| Job | What it does | Lane | Started by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Create site**<br>`site.create` | Creates the site's database and container, installs WordPress, and applies the plugins and recipes chosen on the New site form. | Server | API: `POST /api/sites` |
| **Delete site**<br>`site.delete` | Removes the site's container, database and files, after a final backup when one was asked for. | Server<br>Both servers | API: `DELETE /api/sites/:slug` |
| **Start site**<br>`site.start` | Starts the site's container. | Server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/start`<br>Custom schedule: Start sites |
| **Stop site**<br>`site.stop` | Stops the site's container. The site does not answer until it is started again. | Server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/stop`<br>Custom schedule: Stop sites |
| **Restart site**<br>`site.restart` | Restarts the site's container. | Server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/restart`<br>Custom schedule: Restart sites |
| **Change PHP version**<br>`site.changePhp` | Recreates the site's container on another PHP version. Files and database stay as they are. | Server | API: `PUT /api/sites/:slug/php` |
| **Recreate site container**<br>`site.reconcile` | Recreates the site's container so it runs under the current isolation policy - its networks, its container capabilities and what it may send mail as - and with the certificate its server gives it now. | Server | API: `DELETE /api/dns/token`, `PATCH /api/servers/:id`, `POST /api/sites/:slug/reconcile`, `POST /api/sites/reconcile-all`, `PUT /api/dns/servers/:id/wildcard`<br>Built-in schedule: Site network repair<br>Another job: Apply container limits, Finish panel update<br>The panel itself |
| **Change domains**<br>`site.updateDomains` | Changes the site's hostnames - going live, adding or removing a domain - and updates WordPress's own URLs to match. | Server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/go-live`, `PUT /api/sites/:slug/domains` |
| **Move site**<br>`site.move` | Copies the site to another server and switches its traffic over. The old copy is parked until every hostname points at the new server. | Both servers | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/move` |
| **Finish move**<br>`site.moveFinalize` | Removes the copy a move parked on the old server, once every hostname resolves to the new one. | Server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/move/finalize`<br>Another job: Nightly housekeeping |
| **Import site**<br>`site.import` | Pulls an existing site's files and database from the old host through the migration plugin into a staging folder on the server. | `import`, one per server | API: `POST /api/imports/:id/retry`, `POST /api/imports/:id/run` |
| **Finish import**<br>`site.importFinish` | Brings an imported site up from its staging folder: database, container, WordPress fixes and a first backup. | Server | API: `POST /api/imports/:id/retry`<br>Another job: Import site |
| **Refresh import**<br>`site.importRefresh` | Pulls an imported site's database and changed files from the old host again, with the old site in maintenance, and replaces this site's copy. | Server | API: `POST /api/imports/:id/refresh` |
| **Shell command**<br>`site.shell` | Runs a shell command inside the site's container as www-data and keeps its output in the job log. | `exec`, one per server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/shell`<br>Custom schedule: Shell command |

## Backups

| Job | What it does | Lane | Started by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Back up site**<br>`backup.create` | Dumps the site's database and archives its files into a new backup. | Server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/backups`<br>Built-in schedule: Scheduled backups<br>Custom schedule: Back up |
| **Restore backup**<br>`backup.restore` | Replaces the site's files and database with a backup, after a safety copy of the current state unless that was skipped. | Server | API: `POST /api/backups/:id/restore` |
| **Offsite copy**<br>`backup.offsite` | Uploads a backup to every offsite destination that should hold it. | `offsite`, one per server | API: `PATCH /api/backup-destinations/:id`, `POST /api/backup-destinations`, `POST /api/backups/:id/offsite`, `PUT /api/sites/:slug/offsite-enabled`<br>Built-in schedule: Offsite copies<br>Another job: Back up site, Panel snapshot |
| **Fetch offsite backup**<br>`backup.fetch` | Downloads a backup back from an offsite destination, so it can be restored. | `offsite`, one per server | API: `POST /api/backups/:id/fetch` |
| **Empty offsite destination**<br>`backup.offsitePurge` | Deletes this panel's copies from an offsite destination. | `offsite`, one per server | API: `DELETE /api/backup-destinations/:id` |
| **Delete backups**<br>`backup.delete` | Deletes several backups at once: their files on the server and their copies at the remote destinations. A backup that is in use is left alone and named in the log. | `backup-delete` | API: `POST /api/backups/bulk-delete`<br>Another job: Delete site |
| **Panel snapshot**<br>`panel.snapshot` | Backs up the panel's own database - servers, sites, domains, DKIM keys - which is what a fleet is rebuilt from. | Server | Built-in schedule: Scheduled backups<br>Custom schedule: Panel snapshot |

## WordPress

| Job | What it does | Lane | Started by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Update WordPress**<br>`wp.coreUpdate` | Updates WordPress itself on the site, then re-reads what the site has installed. | Server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/wp/core-update` |
| **Plugin change**<br>`wp.pluginTask` | Installs, activates, deactivates, updates or deletes one plugin on the site. | Server | API: `DELETE /api/sites/:slug/wp/plugins/:name`, `POST /api/sites/:slug/wp/plugins`, `POST /api/sites/:slug/wp/plugins/:name/activate`, `POST /api/sites/:slug/wp/plugins/:name/deactivate`, `POST /api/sites/:slug/wp/plugins/:name/update` |
| **Theme change**<br>`wp.themeTask` | Activates, updates or deletes one theme on the site. | Server | API: `DELETE /api/sites/:slug/wp/themes/:name`, `POST /api/sites/:slug/wp/themes/:name/activate`, `POST /api/sites/:slug/wp/themes/:name/update` |
| **WordPress updates**<br>`wp.bulkTask` | Runs a list of plugin, theme and core operations on one site in one go, optionally after a backup and with a check that the site still answers. Bulk runs and update schedules both use it. | Server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/wp/bulk`, `POST /api/wp/bulk`<br>Custom schedule: Update plugins, themes and WordPress |
| **WordPress inventory scan**<br>`wp.scanAll` | Asks every running site which plugins, themes and WordPress version it has and what has an update, then checks the installed versions against the vulnerability feed. | Shared queue | API: `POST /api/wp/scan`<br>Built-in schedule: WordPress inventory scan<br>Custom schedule: Scan WordPress inventory |
| **Plugin recipes**<br>`wp.recipes` | Runs the recipes that license and set up premium plugins on the site. | Server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/wp/recipes/apply` |
| **WP-CLI command**<br>`wp.cli` | Runs a WP-CLI command inside the site's container and keeps its output in the job log. | `exec`, one per server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/wp/cli`<br>Custom schedule: WP-CLI command |
| **REST API request**<br>`wp.rest` | Sends a request to one of the site's WordPress REST API routes (/wp-json/…), signed in with an application password when it has one, and keeps the response in the job log. Anything but a 2xx answer fails the job. | `exec`, one per server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/wp/rest`<br>Custom schedule: REST API request |

## Files

| Job | What it does | Lane | Started by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Extract archive**<br>`files.extract` | Unpacks an archive among the site's files. | Server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/files/extract` |
| **Compress files**<br>`files.compress` | Packs files and folders of the site into a zip archive. | Server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/files/compress` |

## Security

| Job | What it does | Lane | Started by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Malware scan**<br>`site.malwareScan` | Checks a site's files against wordpress.org's published checksums, then looks for known malware in what those cannot vouch for. Runs in a throwaway container with no network that can only read the site. | `scan`, one per server | API: `POST /api/security/scans`, `POST /api/sites/:slug/security/findings/:id/put-back`, `POST /api/sites/:slug/security/scan`<br>Built-in schedule: Malware scans<br>Another job: Finish import, Reinstall original |
| **Plugin zip check**<br>`plugin.zipCheck` | Unpacks a zip from the plugin catalog in a throwaway container with no network, records each file's hash and scans the files for known malware. Sites that hold its files unchanged have them vouched for. | `scan`, one per server | API: `POST /api/plugins/:id/check`, `POST /api/plugins/upload`<br>Built-in schedule: Malware scans |
| **Reinstall original**<br>`wp.reinstall` | Downloads WordPress or a plugin again from wordpress.org, at the version the site has, over files a malware scan found changed. Then scans the site again. | Server | API: `POST /api/sites/:slug/security/findings/:id/reinstall` |

## Servers

| Job | What it does | Lane | Started by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Set up server**<br>`server.provision` | Installs or updates the server's stack: Docker services, Traefik, MariaDB and the mail relay. | Server | API: `POST /api/servers`, `POST /api/servers/:id/update`<br>Another job: Finish panel update |
| **Sync plugin library**<br>`server.syncPlugins` | Copies the panel's plugin zips to the server, so sites on it can install them. | Server | API: `POST /api/servers` |
| **Apply container limits**<br>`server.applySiteLimits` | Brings every site container on the server to the CPU, memory and process limits in Settings, in place, without a restart. Lifting a CPU cap is the exception: those sites each get a "Recreate site container" job. | Server | API: `PUT /api/settings`<br>Built-in schedule: Container limits follow-up |
| **Move backups**<br>`server.relocateBackups` | Copies a server's backups to a new location, verifies them, and points the server at it. | Server | API: `POST /api/servers/:id/backups/relocate` |

## Panel

| Job | What it does | Lane | Started by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Finish panel update**<br>`system.postUpdate` | What a panel update leaves for the new version to do: bringing servers and sites up to what it expects. | Shared queue | API: `POST /api/system/update/post-update`<br>The panel itself |
| **Nightly housekeeping**<br>`system.housekeeping` | Prunes old backups, statistics, mail and API logs and finished jobs, applies offsite retention, finishes moved sites whose DNS has settled and refreshes the vulnerability feed. | `housekeeping` | Built-in schedule: Nightly housekeeping |
